page_note: Heavily damaged page (78.9%) but content is dominantly substrate cosmology. Two teaching units: (1) end of preceding chapter — narrative about the soul, the Virgin, the Father sending forth mind/thought/teaching/counsel, gathering soul members back to its place; (2) Chapter 32 'Concerning the Seven Works of the Living Spirit' — systematic enumeration of seven cosmogonic acts (raising First Man from the contest like a pearl from the sea; spreading and crucifying; substances of death; ships of light; five sons under the Girdle bearing cosmic burdens; three living words against deceit/molding; mingling with the five). Editorial seams limited to chapter-title machinery (segs 18-20) and one Mani-attribution formula (seg 21) that introduces the substantive cosmology. Enumeration markers preserved as substrate.
